title: code_index.rebuild response
description: Reported identically whether the call reconciled an existing index or built a new one, so a consumer never has to infer which path ran. `mode` says which it was.

mode.description: `refreshed` reconciled the live index against disk; `built` walked, read, and parsed the whole workspace.

files_indexed.description: Files in the index after the call.

files_skipped.description: Files the walk offered that could not be ingested.

files_reindexed.description: Files read from disk during the call. Zero on an unchanged tree.

files_unchanged.description: Files recognised as current from mtime and size, never opened. Zero in `built` mode.

files_removed.description: Files dropped because they no longer exist or no longer pass the filters.
